subject: stat_density trim parameter is not working

messages.author: 0d3b19d35af45801
messages.subject: stat_density trim parameter is not working
parts:
I noticed that the trim parameter of stat_density is not working.See most plots in the documentation: they are all trimmed, altough trim is FALSE by default.
Culprit is the passing of range to the call to density, which trims its estimate to the data range, regardless of trim, instead of to a range determined by the density parameter cut=3 as the documentation says.

I fixed the problem by removing range (and xgrid, which is not used) from the code, see my github. Shall I now send a pull request to hadley/ggplot2?

(I know its only a small change, and I'm fairly new to github, but I hope my contribution helps - and yes, I already fixed my github e-mail settings, next commit will have my name on it)

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: stat_density trim parameter is not working
parts:
See discussion in https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/595

The problem is that I'd rather fix it properly by using a different
class of density estimators, but that's a backward incompatible
change, so it needs to wait for 0.10.

Hadley
